then.text: Saturday at Bethania. I've written it on the bar. Mind, it's written under a pint.
Second tenor? Me? Aye, I sing. But I'll be damned if I give my voice for free. Answer this: who wrote 'Myfanwy', Merthyr's own?
Who wrote 'Myfanwy'?
Joseph Parry! Born a stone's throw from the bar. I'll sing. And I'll bring half the regulars, they'll sing too whether they like it or not.
You found a second tenor for the eisteddfod choir.

else.text: No, bach. Elgar's English. Think of the busker outside the pub: he's humming it. Come back when you know.
Y Dic Penderyn, the pub. Named for the Merthyr boy hanged in Cardiff in 1831. We don't have a statue in here, just a very big portrait and a very strong opinion.
I'm a second tenor on a good night. If there's ever a choir that needs one, ask.

mer_regular.text: Chwarae teg, that's fair play, and you've not had a drink so you're playing fair. I'll have yours.
There's a pub quiz on Thursdays. Tough one. The local history round has a question about every single ironmaster and a different one about what they did to their workers.

then.text: Good luck at the vote. I've got a sandwich and a grudge, and I mean to enjoy both.
The vote is on points. Five Welsh questions. Three right, or better, and I'll second your motion.
Walked off? Dear me.
Right. Right! Fair is fair, I'll second the motion, and I'll say so in the Trust newsletter in my own handwriting.
Tell Cerys at Big Pit I said that, and tell her I'm still annoyed about question four.
Prys Gittins will second your motion at the Trust board.

Not enough. Not by a country mile. Have another go whenever you like. The quiz is on the house, my pride isn't.

Ramblers, eh? Fine. You've walked enough footpaths to have an opinion on them.
One of ours! A Heritage Trust member in good standing. You have a vote, and I'll be sorry to use it against you.

else.text: Prys Gittins, Trust treasurer. You can't move a motion at our board unless you belong to something. Join the Ramblers or the Heritage Trust and earn the first rank. Ten plaques read gets you the first Ramblers badge.

then.text: Seat at the table sorted. Come and see me again when you're ready for the vote. On points, in the pub, because that's how we do business round here.

else.text: Prys Gittins. Trust treasurer, pub quizmaster by nobody's appointment. Come back when you've got something to propose.
